overview: Naturopathic detoxification protocols aim to stimulate the body's natural emunctories (liver, kidneys, colon, lungs, skin, and lymph) to efficiently eliminate metabolic waste and environmental toxins. These protocols emphasize a phased approach: preparation, active detox, and rebuilding.

7_day_protocol.days_1_to_3: Preparation: Eliminate caffeine, sugar, refined carbs, and animal proteins. Transition to a plant-based diet focusing on cruciferous vegetables.
7_day_protocol.days_4_to_6: Active Cleanse: Liquid diet. Drink fresh apple juice, carrot-beetroot juice, and warm water with lemon.
7_day_protocol.day_7: Flush: Morning intake of epsom salt solution, followed by an evening dose of cold-pressed olive oil mixed with fresh grapefruit juice. Rest completely.

14_day_protocol.description: A milder, longer protocol focusing on dietary restriction and herbal support rather than a harsh flush. Suitable for moderate liver stagnation.
14_day_protocol.daily_routine: Morning lemon water, minimum 1 raw salad daily, dandelion root tea twice daily. No processed foods.

hydrotherapy_support: Hot fomentation over the liver area followed by a cold compress
Castor oil pack over the right side of the abdomen

3_day_juice_fast.protocol: Consume only fresh vegetable juices (celery, cucumber, spinach, apple) and water. Minimum 3 liters of fluid daily. Administer a warm water enema every morning.

7_day_fiber_cleanse.protocol: Plant-based diet. Take 1 tablespoon of psyllium husk mixed with 1 glass of water twice daily, immediately followed by another glass of water. Take Triphala at night.

enema_protocol.day_1: Plain warm water enema to clear bulk waste.
enema_protocol.day_2: Chamomile or Neem tea enema to soothe inflammation.
enema_protocol.day_3: Coffee enema (optional, if advised) for liver stimulation via the portal vein.

protocol.instructions: Consume large amounts of fluid. Start the day with cranberry juice (unsweetened) or lemon water. Eat high-water content fruits like watermelon. Avoid salt, heavy proteins, and dairy.

dry_brushing.method: Use a natural bristle brush on dry skin before showering. Brush with long sweeping strokes towards the heart, starting from the feet and hands. Do this daily for 5-10 minutes.
dry_brushing.benefits: Stimulates lymphatic flow, removes dead skin cells, opens pores.

exercise_protocol.yoga: Inversions such as Viparita Karani (Legs Up the Wall) and Sarvangasana (Shoulder Stand) to reverse gravity's effect on lymph.

mud_pack_protocol.method: Apply a paste of clean, sun-dried, pulverized earth (multani mitti or specific therapeutic mud) mixed with water over the abdomen or face.
mud_pack_protocol.benefits: Absorbs toxins, cools the body, reduces inflammation.

sun_therapy.method: Expose the bare skin to early morning sunlight (heliotherapy) for 20-30 minutes. Promotes sweating and Vitamin D synthesis.

diet_protocol.instructions: Increase intake of antioxidant-rich foods, Vitamin C, and Zinc. Hydrate thoroughly to allow sweating.

spring_detox.foods: Bitter greens, dandelion, sprouts, light foods

summer_detox.practices: Light eating, cooling hydrotherapy, gentle yoga

winter_detox.foods: Warm soups, stews, bone broths (if applicable), nuts
winter_detox.practices: Rest, hot baths, warming spices, kidney support herbs

warning_signs_during_detox: Healing Crisis (Herxheimer Reaction): temporary worsening of symptoms, headaches, fatigue, skin breakouts.
contraindications: Extreme exhaustion, cachexia, or severe anemia.
Active cancer treatments (chemotherapy/radiation) unless advised by a practitioner.
